thesis: Buying an extended, richly valued stock at a 52-week high into a risk-off tape with a cluster of insider selling is poor timing. The intraday high of 90.71 faded to a close of 88.87, which is a rejection at the highs, and the stock is 5.2% above SMA20 with RSI near 69. The reward/risk of about 1.4 is thin for a 37x trailing P/E name that has no fresh catalyst, since the Q2 beat was priced in on 11/5. In a regime where QQQ is below its 50- and 200-day averages and VIX is at a 0.858 percentile, high-multiple stocks are vulnerable to a de-rating if rates (^TNX 5.089) keep climbing. Insiders (an EVP and two directors) sold into the highs, so the people with the best information are not adding.
